{{Quote|The Jedi? ''[&hellip;]'' For ten thousand years they sat on Tython, staring into the stars and debating the nature of the cosmos, like a sewing circle of widows on Peshara.|Filed selections from the debriefing of Arden Lyn|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
'''Peshara''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Peshara system/Legends|Peshara system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated in the [[Arrowhead]] region, a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], agents of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] awakened the former [[Steel Hand of Palawa]] [[Arden Lyn]] from [[24,500 BBY|twenty-four-millennia]]-long stasis and debriefed her, with selections of the debriefing being filed by<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] [[Laddinare Torbin]].<ref name="Gamer5">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref>

In her debriefing, Lyn mockingly compared the ten-[[Millennium/Legends|thousand-year]]-long existence of<ref name="EGTW" /> the [[Je'daii Order]], an organization of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] that had been based on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]<ref name="DotJ0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref> and had dispassionately contemplated the nature of the [[Universe/Legends|universe]], to "a sewing circle of widows on Peshara."<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Peshara was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Peshara [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square L-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
